meta.name: browser-automation
meta.description: Use when the user asks to automate browser tasks, scrape websites, fill forms, capture screenshots, extract structured data from web pages, or build web automation workflows. NOT for testing — use playwright-pro for that.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动执行浏览器操作，如填表、截图和提取数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用脚本控制浏览器完成重复性网页任务
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser tasks like form filling, screenshots, and data extraction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to script browser actions for repetitive web tasks

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能自动控制浏览器，帮你抓取网页数据、填写表单、截图、提取结构化信息，并管理登录会话。
howto.when: 当你要求自动化浏览器任务，如抓取网站、填写表单、截图、提取网页结构化数据或构建浏览器自动化工作流时触发。

say.text: 帮我抓取这个网页上的产品列表，包括名称和价格。
say.note: Claude 会启动浏览器，提取数据并返回 JSON。

say.text: 登录我的账户，然后下载上个月的报告。
say.note: Claude 会执行登录流程，保存会话，然后导航并下载文件。

say.text: 截取这个页面的全屏截图，保存为图片。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can control a browser to scrape websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract structured data, and manage login sessions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to automate browser tasks such as scraping websites, filling forms, capturing screenshots, extracting structured data from web pages, or building web automation workflows.

say_en.text: Scrape the product list from this page, including names and prices.
say_en.note: Claude will launch a browser, extract data, and return JSON.

say_en.text: Log into my account and download last month's report.
say_en.note: Claude will perform login, save session, navigate, and download the file.

say_en.text: Take a full-page screenshot of this page and save it as an image.
say_en.note: Claude will use Playwright's screenshot feature to capture the full page.
